newsitem.title: USA: Addwest boosts mine reserve by 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Addwest boosts mine reserve by 17 pct.

text.p: Addwest Minerals International Ltd said on Friday that it increased proven and probable reserves by 17 percent at its Gold Road underground mine in Arizona.
The reserves increased by 20,950 ounces, or 77,000 tons grading 0.272 ounces per ton, in proven and probable reserves at the mine.

As of March 31, 1997, proven and probable reserves at Gold Road totaled 130,000 ounces, or 556,000 tons grading 0.234 ounces per ton, Addwest said. Increased reserves more than offset first quarter production.
At Gold Road's current production rate of 40,000 ounces per year, these additional reserves will extend the mine life by half a year, the company said.
This represents a significant step toward the 1997 goal of increasing Gold Road's mine life by two years and the long-term goal of extending the mine life to ten years or more, Addwest said.
